I wouldn't even bring it up if it wasn't so persistent, but they've been using, you know, deliberately misdelivered mail, and these perfectly timed noises in the walls, plus little comments from the neighbors... all to pressure me out of the apartment. 

I know how it might sound, and I hope you don't think I'm overreacting, but as a management analyst, my whole career is based on recognizing trends.
